messages:
anna (frontend): heads up — dashboards spike after today's canary. heatmap + metric panels hang ~2s on first paint :eyes:

mike (platform): saw it too, reproduced in canary. charts stall on first data fetch. suspect new embedlib chunk size.

fran (eng-platform): timeline? which deploy?

anna (frontend): canary 2026-03-21T14:05 (deploy-bot: 1718243500). quick trace shows long parse for /static/chunks/embedlib-0a3f.js (~900ms)

katy (sre): telemetry shows KV-prefetch increase in misses during that window, maybe routing/quota backpressure.

mike (platform): i pulled a flamegraph — CPU blocked on code splitting parse/compile. also saw repeated kvcache GETs for same prefix.

anna (frontend): log snippet:
```
parseTime  embedlib-0a3f.js  892ms
kvcache miss prefixKey=metrics:ds:heatmap route=eu-west quota=low
```

fran (eng-platform): is this the bundle that was switched to eager preload in PR #4821?

anna (frontend): yes. we flipped a preload flag to reduce tail-latency for rare routes, seems to backfire.

mike (platform): theory: preload causes big chunk to hit main thread and kvcache prefetch floods routing policy, hitting quota -> retry storms -> longer paint.

katy (sre): can we toggle preload on canary origin to verify? if it's preload-related, you should see immediate regression revert.

anna (frontend): i'll push a hotfix toggle to canary now (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4829)

deploy-bot: deploy started to canary (canary/next) — 1718243588

mike (platform): if toggle helps, we should consider: 1) split embedlib into smaller chunks; 2) change kvcache prefetch backoff; 3) routing policy: raise short-term quota for prefetches.

fran (eng-platform): also add SLO guard: if parseTime > 300ms, skip preload for that route.

anna (frontend): test results: toggled preload off on canary. initial paint back to normal in lab, KV miss rate dropped ~60%.

katy (sre): great. canary metrics look stable. will monitor for 30m.

mike (platform): creating a tracking ticket for routing quota tuning + bundle split RFC.

fran (eng-platform): pls add perf regression test that measures first-paint on heatmap route.

anna (frontend): will open follow-ups. thanks all :thumbsup:

katy (sre): heads-up: alert rule for heatmap LCP already modified to add a warning threshold.

deploy-bot: deploy to canary completed — 1718243618

anna (frontend): marking thread resolved for now, will update ticket with numbers.
